defects.name: Future-mark acceptance
defects.description: cycle() accepts PriceEvidenceV2 marks with observed_at and available_at after cycle.now without validation. The code only checks health.state is HEALTHY but never validates the mark's timestamps against the current cycle time. A mark at T+15min when the cycle is at T is accepted and persisted.
defects.reproduction: test_future_observed_at_accepted_by_current_impl: mark with observed_offset=15, available_offset=15 accepted at cycle T. Result: ledger.snapshot.position.mark_price == Decimal('51000') (accepted). Required: should raise.
defects.required_behavior: Reject future evidence (observed_at > cycle.now or available_at > cycle.now). Fail closed. Do not persist. Test observed_at and available_at independently including equality boundaries (observed_at == cycle.now accepted).

defects.name: Startup reconciliation gap
defects.description: start() creates empty accounting (PaperPerformanceLedgerV1.create with initial_accounting) when no performance checkpoint exists, even if the adapter checkpoint has retained fills with nonzero filled_quantity. The code does not check whether the adapter's gateway records have fills that are absent from the accounting. It creates empty accounting and returns successfully.
defects.reproduction: test_missing_perf_checkpoint_with_retained_fill_accepted_by_current_impl: adapter with retained fill, no performance checkpoint, start() succeeds with empty accounting. Result: ledger.snapshot.position.signed_quantity == Decimal('0'). Required: should reject.
defects.required_behavior: Refuse successful startup when adapter has retained fills not reflected in accounting. Preserve retained fill evidence. Activate durable halt when adapter store is writable. Also test existing performance checkpoint missing a retained gateway fill.

observations.description: Checkpoint files are individually atomically replaced, not committed together as one atomic transaction. The adapter and performance checkpoints are separate stores with independent lock files.
The prior audit's alert test used a broad exception-only check. Corrected to assert specific error, persisted kill-switch/disconnected state, health state, and alert content.
The prior audit included 3 docstring-only classification tests in behavioral test counts. These have been separated from behavioral tests.
